destination.title: Supersymmetry breaking, mediation and particle–cosmology scales
destination.question: How do proposed sources and mediation mechanisms of supersymmetry breaking connect particle spectra, electroweak scales, vacuum energy and cosmological viability, and what observations or conditional consistency arguments constrain them?
destination.summary: Original-scope assessment: only numerical memberships were supplied, without an original scientific scope statement. The descriptions support this broad organizing question, but not a single mechanism, universal quantum-gravity premise or common observational test. The proposed overview preserves ordinary supersymmetry phenomenology, conditional quantum-gravity extensions and useful alternate access.

evidence.text: Which MSSM soft-term patterns follow from Kähler-modulus-dominated supersymmetry breaking, and which survive radiative electroweak breaking, the paper's experimental and dark-matter constraints, and prospective LHC tests?

sources.title: Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking in a Class of String Theory Models

evidence.text: Can a minimal moduli-plus-MSSM string effective theory generate flavor-suppressed soft terms, acceptable Higgs parameters, and gaugino masses while including supergravity quadratic divergences and tuning the cosmological constant?

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking at Low Energies

evidence.text: How can dynamical, possibly metastable supersymmetry breaking at low energies produce viable gauge-mediated soft terms, address flavor and hierarchy problems, and motivate possible collider phenomenology?

sources.title: Compactified String Theories -- Generic Predictions for Particle Physics

evidence.text: Which correlated particle-physics and dark-matter predictions follow from compactified string/M theory under low-energy supersymmetry, grand unification and cosmological constraints?

sources.title: Revisiting the SUSY $\mu$ problem and its solutions in the LHC era

evidence.text: Which proposed solutions forbid the supersymmetric μ term and regenerate |μ| near 100–300 GeV while accommodating multi-TeV soft breaking, and which also address axion quality, neutrino masses or experimentally distinguishable signatures?

sources.title: Status of weak scale supersymmetry after LHC Run 2 and ton-scale noble liquid WIMP searches

evidence.text: Does the reported absence of SUSY and WIMP signals exclude natural weak-scale supersymmetry, or do revised naturalness criteria, a PQ sector, and landscape selection motivate viable spectra and different search strategies?

sources.title: Light Higgsinos for electroweak naturalness in mirage-mediated high-scale supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can KKLT-inspired mirage mediation retain percent-level electroweak naturalness with multi-TeV superpartners, while allowing light Higgsinos consistent with gauge coupling unification and the observed Higgs mass?

sources.title: The Scale of Supersymmetry Breaking and the Dark Dimension

evidence.text: Can the Dark Dimension proposal and the Gravitino Conjecture connect the observed dark energy density to supersymmetry breaking, and which tower configurations and string-inspired effective models support that connection?

sources.title: Phenomenology of mixed modulus-anomaly mediation in fluxed string compactifications and brane models

evidence.text: What low-energy sparticle spectra and electroweak symmetry breaking follow when nonperturbative modulus stabilization and sequestered uplifting produce comparable modulus- and anomaly-mediated soft terms?

sources.title: SUSY phenomenology of KKLT flux compactifications

evidence.text: Can KKLT-motivated mixed modulus–anomaly mediation with the MSSM on D7 branes yield acceptable electroweak breaking, a viable superpartner spectrum, and neutralino dark matter under the paper's experimental and cosmological constraints?

sources.title: Little SUSY hierarchy in mixed modulus-anomaly mediation

evidence.text: Can KKLT-motivated mixed modulus-anomaly mediation generate loop-suppressed Higgs soft masses relative to sparticle masses, together with viable µ and B, addressing the little hierarchy motivated by the paper's contemporary MSSM Higgs bound?

sources.title: Sparticle spectrum and EWSB of mixed modulus-anomaly mediation in fluxed string compactification models

evidence.text: How does comparable modulus and anomaly mediation in KKLT compactifications affect the low-energy sparticle spectrum, electroweak symmetry breaking, and the composition of a possible neutralino dark-matter candidate?

sources.title: The Gaugino code

evidence.text: What information about supersymmetry breaking and mediation could be inferred from TeV-scale gaugino mass ratios, which patterns are shared by different mechanisms, and when can heavy-spectrum uncertainties be avoided?

sources.title: Cosmological implications of dynamical supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Which dynamical supersymmetry-breaking scenarios can generate the weak/Planck hierarchy while satisfying particle phenomenology, a tuned small cosmological constant, and early-universe cosmology?

sources.title: Supersymmetry, the cosmological constant, and a theory of quantum gravity in our universe

evidence.text: Can a positive cosmological constant, treated as a defining parameter of quantum gravity, explain supersymmetry breaking and constrain particle physics? The central quantitative question is how the gravitino mass depends on Λ and whether this mechanism implies TeV-range superpartners.

sources.title: The Intermediate scale branch of the landscape

evidence.text: Can the intermediate-scale landscape branch yield generic, conditional predictions for moduli and superpartner spectra, and can dark-matter selection explain apparent weak-scale tuning?

sources.title: Modulus-dominated SUSY-breaking soft terms in F-theory and their test at LHC

evidence.text: Run GUT-scale boundaries using modified SPheno2.2.3 and iterative loop-corrected REWSB, including the predicted B condition. Compute relic density with micrOMEGAs and impose historical mass/rare-decay bounds. Muon g−2 compatibility is displayed but not imposed.

sources.title: Mediation of Supersymmetry Breaking in a Class of String Theory Models

evidence.text: The author applies supergravity supertrace and curvature formulas to the leading quadratically divergent one-loop effective potential and unnormalized soft masses, then retunes the classical vacuum energy against the loop contribution.

sources.title: Supersymmetry Breaking at Low Energies

evidence.text: Messenger-loop calculations generate gaugino masses at one loop and scalar masses at two loops; supergraphs and background-field methods are mentioned. General Gauge Mediation organizes hidden-sector information through gauge-supercurrent correlation functions.

sources.title: Compactified String Theories -- Generic Predictions for Particle Physics

evidence.text: Higgs calculations integrate out heavy scalars, match the Higgs quartic including threshold corrections, include superpartner-fermion loop effects, and use RG evolution. The displayed prediction is described as two-loop.

sources.title: Revisiting the SUSY $\mu$ problem and its solutions in the LHC era

evidence.text: Reviews RG evolution driving PQ-sector soft masses negative and numerical scalar-potential minimization. Gravity-safety tests enumerate symmetry-allowed PQ-violating superpotential operators and examine their interference contributions to the F-term scalar potential.

sources.title: Status of weak scale supersymmetry after LHC Run 2 and ton-scale noble liquid WIMP searches

evidence.text: Collider forecasts use Madgraph, Pythia, Delphes, event selection, and Poisson reach estimates. Mixed axion–WIMP relic-density studies solve eight coupled Boltzmann equations, treating coherent oscillations and thermal/decay production separately.

sources.title: Cosmological aspects of gauge mediated supersymmetry breakdown

evidence.text: Under what conditions can gauge-mediated supersymmetry breaking survive early-universe evolution: selection of a metastable SUSY-breaking vacuum, decay of the spurion, thermal stability of a volume modulus, and acceptable gravitino production?

sources.title: Cosmological breaking of supersymmetry?

evidence.text: Can a positive cosmological constant account for all supersymmetry breaking, with quantum-gravitational effects explaining why the breaking scale greatly exceeds the classical supergravity estimate Λ^(1/4)?

sources.title: A Gravitino-rich Universe

evidence.text: Can high-scale supersymmetry support a viable gravitino-rich or gravitino-dominated early Universe, including entropy production, dark matter and baryogenesis, and which production mechanisms realize it?

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: How can a supergravity model with broken local supersymmetry avoid a vacuum energy density of order m_{3/2}²M_Pl² and account for a much smaller positive cosmological energy density?

sources.title: Light and compressed gluinos at the LHC via string theory

evidence.text: Can Bayesian fits of a specified string-inspired LVS parameter family to low-energy particle data constrain that family and forecast collider spectra, especially light gluinos with compressed decay kinematics?

sources.title: Out of this world supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry breaking away from the visible brane naturally suppress flavor-dependent soft terms while unavoidable anomaly-mediated contributions generate viable, predictive gaugino and scalar masses?

sources.title: Brane world SUSY breaking

evidence.text: Does physically separating visible matter and supersymmetry breaking on different branes enforce a sequestered Kähler potential, suppress tree-level scalar masses, and make anomaly mediation a generic solution to the supersymmetric flavor problem?

sources.title: The FL bound and its phenomenological implications

evidence.text: How can the conjectural Festina Lente bound be sharpened and extended to higher dimensions, scalar-dependent couplings and charged towers, and what conditional consequences follow for particle physics, dimensional reduction and antibrane uplifting?

sources.title: 50 years of SUSY and SUGRA, circa 1974–2024 and future prospects

evidence.text: Review how SUSY, local supersymmetry, gravity-mediated breaking and SUGRA grand unification developed, and assess their particle-physics, cosmological and string-theory motivations and experimental prospects.

sources.title: Is gauge mediation in the swampland?

evidence.text: Does the proposed global festina lente (GFL) bound constrain supersymmetry-breaking mediation to the supersymmetric Standard Model, particularly gauge mediation, and which mechanisms evade the constraint when gravity decouples?

sources.title: Radiative Generation of dS from AdS

evidence.text: Can quantum fluctuations below the Kaluza–Klein scale raise the negative cosmological constant of a supersymmetry-breaking LVS minimum to a positive infrared value, under suitable conditions on the low-energy spectrum?

sources.title: Constraints on LVS Compactifications of IIB String Theory

evidence.text: Which versions of type IIB LVS remain phenomenologically viable after imposing effective-supergravity validity, flavor constraints, nonperturbative matter couplings and cosmology? The author argues that a sequestered scenario with Weyl-anomaly and RG-generated soft terms is favored.

sources.title: On the F-term problem and quintessence supersymmetry breaking

evidence.text: Can supersymmetry breaking from rolling quintessence, mediated through kinetic couplings, generate substantial scalar and Majorana gaugino masses without spoiling slow roll or introducing pathological kinetic terms?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking in Local String/F-Theory Models

evidence.text: How strongly does bulk LARGE-volume supersymmetry breaking generate gravity and anomaly mediated soft terms on local Standard Model/GUT branes, and what follows for gauge mediation and the cosmological moduli problem?

sources.title: The Swampland Conjectures: A Bridge from Quantum Gravity to Particle Physics

evidence.text: Does Festina Lente reasoning constrain how small non-abelian vector masses and confinement scales can be relative to the Hubble scale? The reviewed application addresses both types of scale, without specifying a particular gauge group or spectrum.

sources.title: The gravitino and the swampland

evidence.text: Can quantum-gravity consistency constrain the gravitino Lagrangian mass and thereby inform the supersymmetry-breaking scale? The motivating near-Minkowski estimate is M_SUSY² ≃ m_{3/2}M_P.

sources.title: Dark Energy density in Split SUSY models inspired by degenerate vacua

evidence.text: Can a physical SUSY-breaking vacuum, assumed degenerate with a second initially supersymmetric vacuum, inherit a small positive dark-energy density generated by strong dynamics in that second phase, and what Split SUSY scales would reproduce the paper's observational target?

sources.title: SUSY Breaking at the Tip of Throat and Mirage Mediation

evidence.text: Could superparticle masses reconstructed from gluino and squark cascades distinguish the conditional mirage-mediation pattern?

sources.title: The Phenomenology of the Dark Dimension and Non-Supersymmetric Strings

evidence.text: Can Swampland principles and tiny positive dark energy connect dark matter, neutrino, axion, weak and GUT scales, while motivating non-supersymmetric positive-energy critical points in the interior of moduli space?

sources.title: Cosmology of F-theory GUTs

evidence.text: Can the restricted particle-physics parameters of F-theory GUTs satisfy gravitino dark-matter, BBN and baryon-asymmetry constraints, particularly through the cosmological evolution of the supersymmetry-breaking axion supermultiplet?

sources.title: Supersymmetry With Prejudice: Fitting the Wrong Model to LHC Data

evidence.text: Can reconstructed golden-cascade kinematic endpoints from hypothetical 1 fb^−1 of 14 TeV LHC data distinguish a CMSSM benchmark from simpler alternative supersymmetry-breaking models, once experimental and theoretical uncertainties are included?

sources.title: Smallness of the cosmological constant and the multiple point principle

evidence.text: Can the symmetries responsible for no-scale vacuum-energy cancellation be broken enough to permit local supersymmetry breaking while retaining zero classical vacuum energy?

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Which supersymmetry-breaking contributions can cancel a small negative vacuum energy without overwhelming the non-perturbatively generated gravitino scale? The source explores existing uplift proposals and their compatibility with flux-stabilized sectors.

sources.title: Natural Heavy Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can cosmological relaxation scan supersymmetry breaking and dynamically explain a weak scale far below superpartner masses, while supersymmetry protects scalar naturalness at higher energies?
